description: This file defines the ModelCatalogLoader enum responsible for loading, resolving, and caching a JavaScript representation of model catalog data for an application. It includes functions for path resolution, sanitization of JavaScript source, and integrating with JavaScriptCore to parse model data.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and parses a model catalog from a specified path, returning a sorted list of ModelChoice objects.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath()
methods.description: Resolves the default path for the model catalog, preferring cached or bundled files.

methods.name: resolvePath(preferred:)
methods.description: Resolves the model catalog path based on a preferred input, falling back to bundled or cached paths if necessary.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath()
methods.description: Returns the path to the bundled 'models.generated.js' resource if available.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath()
methods.description: Attempts to locate the model catalog within node_modules directories.

methods.name: cacheCatalog(sourcePath:)
methods.description: Caches the model catalog source file into the cache directory.

methods.name: sanitize(source:)
methods.description: Sanitizes the JavaScript source string to ensure it correctly defines the MODELS object.
